comment: The most findings of each kind the screenshot harness may report before the build fails. Lower a number whenever a change earns it; raising one is a decision that belongs in a review, not a commit message. Measured over the full page set, including the create-exercise/routine/plan/workout flows. smallTapTargets went 6 -> 7 for the circuit session: it is the same 24px remove-set badge the other set grids carry, on one more page, and WorkoutSetGrid says in a comment why that one control sits under the floor.
